_note: plan-ledger MCP server for Cursor 3.x — 53 tools registered (47 ledger + 6 RAG sidecar). Cursor 2.4+ dropped the 40-tool cap and lazy-loads MCP tools, so the full surface works with no clipping. This file (a repo-local .cursor/mcp.json) targets THIS checkout via ${workspaceFolder}; for a global install, copy the server entry into ~/.cursor/mcp.json and hard-code the absolute path there. '_note' is an inert annotation Cursor ignores — delete it if a strict JSON parser ever complains. See docs/CURSOR.md.

env._docs: PLAN_LEDGER_DB defaults to ~/Documents/plan-ledger/data/plan-ledger.db (the store shares that path across every entry point). Uncomment PLAN_LEDGER_DB below to pin a workspace-local ledger instead, and PLAN_LEDGER_RAG_DB to isolate the disposable RAG sidecar.
